gmail.step1: Kunna 2-Step Verification a asusun Google da za ka aika daga gare shi.
gmail.step2: Ƙirƙiri kalmar sirrin app mai suna {storeName}, sannan ka kwafi kalmar sirrin mai haruffa 16. Google yana nuna ta sau ɗaya kawai.
gmail.step3: Shigar da sabar da tashar a sama, cikakken adireshin Gmail ɗinka a matsayin sunan mai amfani, da kalmar sirrin app a matsayin kalmar sirri.
gmail.step4: Don aikawa da wani adireshi, kamar info@yourstore.com, ƙara shi a Gmail tukuna a ƙarƙashin Settings → Accounts and Import → Send mail as.
gmail.step5: Ajiye, sannan ka aika imel na gwaji.
gmail.caution: Asusun Gmail na kai yana aika har imel 500 a rana, Google Workspace har 2,000. Shago mai yawan oda yana buƙatar sabis na aika imel.

zoho.step1: Yi amfani da smtppro.zoho.com don adireshi a kan domain naka, ko smtp.zoho.com don wanda ya ƙare da @zoho.com.
zoho.step2: Kana amfani da shiga mai matakai biyu? Ƙirƙiri kalmar sirrin app a ƙarƙashin Security → App Passwords, ka yi amfani da ita a matsayin kalmar sirri.
zoho.step3: Shigar da sabar da tashar 587 a sama, da cikakken adireshin Zoho ɗinka a matsayin sunan mai amfani.
zoho.step4: Ajiye, sannan ka aika imel na gwaji.
zoho.caution: Asusu a wani yanki yana amfani da sabar wannan yankin, kamar smtppro.zoho.in ko smtppro.zoho.eu.

hosting.step1: A cPanel, buɗe Email Accounts sannan ka danna Connect Devices kusa da adireshin da za ka aika daga gare shi.
hosting.step2: A ƙarƙashin Secure SSL/TLS Settings, kwafi Outgoing Server da SMTP Port.
hosting.step3: Shigar da su a sama, da cikakken adireshin imel a matsayin sunan mai amfani, da kalmar sirrin wannan akwatin saƙon.
hosting.step4: Ajiye, sannan ka aika imel na gwaji.
hosting.caution: Kuskuren takardar shaida yawanci yana nufin sunan sabar daban ne. Yi amfani da wanda cPanel ya nuna, ko da yana kama da server123.yourhost.com.

brevo.step1: A Brevo, buɗe SMTP & API, sannan SMTP tab, ka kwafi sunan shiga na SMTP. Yana ƙarewa da @smtp-brevo.com.
brevo.step2: Danna Generate a new SMTP key ka kwafi maɓallin. Kalmar sirrin Brevo ɗinka ba ta aiki a nan.
brevo.step3: A Brevo, ƙara imel na mai aikawa cikin masu aikawa, ko ka tantance domain naka.
brevo.step4: Shigar da sabar da tashar a sama, sunan shiga na SMTP a matsayin sunan mai amfani, maɓallin kuma a matsayin kalmar sirri.
brevo.step5: Ajiye, sannan ka aika imel na gwaji.
brevo.caution: Kana aikawa daga domain naka? Ƙara bayanan SPF da DKIM da Brevo ya ba ka, in ba haka ba imel ɗinka na iya faɗawa cikin spam.

sendgrid.step1: A SendGrid, buɗe Settings → API Keys ka ƙirƙiri maɓalli mai izinin Mail Send. SendGrid yana nuna shi sau ɗaya kawai.
sendgrid.step2: Tabbatar da imel na mai aikawa, ko dukan domain naka, a ƙarƙashin Settings → Sender Authentication.
sendgrid.step3: Shigar da sabar da tashar a sama. Sunan mai amfani shi ne kalmar apikey, kalmar sirri kuma ita ce maɓallin.
sendgrid.step4: Ajiye, sannan ka aika imel na gwaji.
sendgrid.caution: SendGrid yana ƙin imel daga adireshin mai aikawa da bai tabbatar da shi ba.

ses.step1: A console ɗin Amazon SES, tabbatar da domain naka ko imel na mai aikawa a ƙarƙashin Identities.
ses.step2: Buɗe SMTP settings ka kwafi SMTP endpoint. Sannan ka danna Create SMTP credentials ka kwafi sunan mai amfani da kalmar sirri: ana nuna su sau ɗaya kawai.
ses.step3: Shigar da su a sama. Maɓallan shiga na AWS ba sa aiki a nan.
ses.step4: Ajiye, sannan ka aika imel na gwaji.
ses.caution: Sabon asusu yana iya aikawa ne kawai zuwa adiresoshin da aka tabbatar. Nemi production access kafin shagonka ya buɗe wa jama'a.

other.step1: Nemi “SMTP settings” a shafukan taimako na mai bada sabis ɗinka, ko ka tambaye su sabar imel mai fita.

localRetired.title: An daina amfani da ma’ajiya ta gida
localRetired.body: Fayilolin da ke kan wannan sabar suna ci gaba da aiki, amma sabbin ɗorawa suna buƙatar ɗaya daga cikin masu bada sabis da ke ƙasa. Zaɓi ɗaya, shigar da bayanansa, sannan buɗe “Matsar da fayilolin da kake da su” — a can akwai umarnin da kuma madadin da za a ɗauka kafin turawa na gaba.

cloudflare_r2.bucket: A cikin dashboard ɗin Cloudflare buɗe R2 → Create bucket. Sunansa yana shiga cikin Sunan bucket a sama.
cloudflare_r2.token: R2 → Manage R2 API Tokens → Create API token, izini Object Read & Write, na wannan bucket kaɗai. Kwafa sassan biyu zuwa Access Key ID da Secret Access Key a sama — ana nuna sirrin sau ɗaya kawai.
cloudflare_r2.account: Kwafa Account ID mai haruffa 32 daga gefen shafin R2 zuwa filin R2 Account ID.
cloudflare_r2.public: Bucket → Settings → Public access: kunna subdomain ɗin r2.dev ko haɗa domain naka, sannan liƙa wannan adireshin cikin URL na jama’a.
cloudflare_r2.test: Danna Gwada haɗi, sannan ka adana. Gwajin yana ɗora fayil ɗin gwaji ya sake karanta shi ta hanyar public URL, don haka zai gaza idan an tsallake matakin da ya gabata.
cloudflare_r2.caution: Ba tare da URL na jama’a ba, kowace hoton kaya zai dawo da 403 a mai bincike ko da bayanan shiga sun yi daidai — fayilolin suna zuwa daga endpoint ɗin R2 na sirri, wanda ba a taɓa karanta shi ba tare da izini ba. Domain naka ya fi r2.dev: sai CDN ɗin Cloudflare ya amsa buƙatun da aka ajiye ba tare da caji bucket ba.

s3.bucket: Ƙirƙiri bucket a console ɗin S3 kuma ka lura da yankinsa — dole ya yi daidai da yankin da aka zaɓa a sama.
s3.iam: IAM → ƙirƙiri mai amfani da damar shiga ta shirye-shirye da manufa da ke ba da waɗannan ayyuka a kan wannan bucket:
s3.public: Ba da izinin karatun jama'a ta manufar bucket, ko sanya CloudFront a gaba, sannan liƙa adireshin da aka samu cikin URL na jama’a.
s3.test: Liƙa maɓallan biyu a sama, danna Gwada haɗi, sannan ka adana.
s3.caution: Sabbin bucket suna zuwa da Block all public access a kunne. Ka bar shi a kunne kawai idan kana bayarwa ta CloudFront — in ba haka ba kowace hoto a shago zai dawo da 403.

minio.run: Gudanar da MinIO kusa da manhajar — Coolify da Dokploy duk suna da samfurin danna sau ɗaya. Haɗa volume a /data, in ba haka ba turawa na gaba zai ɗauke duk fayilolin da aka ɗora.
minio.keys: Buɗe console ɗin MinIO (tashar 9001 ta asali), ƙirƙiri bucket, sannan Access Keys → Create access key.
minio.public: Bar masu bincike su karanta bucket:
minio.fields: Endpoint URL shine adireshin API (tashar 9000), ba console ba. Yankin zai iya zama us-east-1 — MinIO baya kula da shi. URL na jama’a shine inda masu bincike ke isa bucket.
minio.test: Danna Gwada haɗi, sannan ka adana.
minio.caution: Bayar da MinIO ta HTTPS a kan subdomain nasa. Masu bincike suna toshe abun ciki gauraye, don haka endpoint ɗin http:// yana lalata kowace hoto a shagon HTTPS.

digitalocean.space: Spaces Object Storage → Create a Space. Cibiyar bayanan da ka zaɓa ita ce endpoint (nyc3, fra1, sgp1…), don haka zaɓi wacce ke kusa da abokan cinikinka kuma zaɓi yanki ɗaya a sama.
digitalocean.keys: API → Spaces Keys → Generate New Key, sannan kwafa sassan biyu zuwa Access Key ID da Secret Access Key.
digitalocean.public: Space → Settings → saita File Listing zuwa jama'a, ko kunna CDN.
digitalocean.test: Bar URL na jama’a fanko don bayarwa kai tsaye daga Space, ko liƙa endpoint ɗin CDN (…cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com) don bayarwa daga gefe. Sannan gwada haɗin ka adana.
digitalocean.caution: Sunan Space shine Sunan bucket a sama, kuma ba za a iya matsar da Space zuwa wata cibiyar bayanai daga baya ba — ana kayyade yankinsa lokacin ƙirƙira.

migration.title: Matsar da fayilolin da kake da su
migration.intro: Zaɓar mai bada sabis yana canza inda sabbin ɗorawa za su tafi kawai. Duk abin da aka ɗora a baya yana nan inda yake kuma yana ci gaba da aiki har sai ka matsar da shi.
migration.step1: Saita mai bada sabis a sama sannan danna Gwada haɗi — ƙaura tana ɗorawa zuwa abin da aka adana a nan.
migration.step2: Matsar da bayanan shiga da aka adana zuwa tsarin kowane mai bada sabis. Yana da aminci a kowace siga, kuma baya yin komai bayan an gudanar sau ɗaya.
migration.step3: Ɗora fayilolin cikin gida kuma sake rubuta URL ɗinsu a duk faɗin bayanan. Gwajin bushe yana lissafa kowane fayil kuma baya rubuta komai.
migration.step4: Duba shagon da Laburaren kafofi. Ba a taɓa share komai daga faifai ba, don haka ka cire kwafin cikin gida da kanka bayan hotunan sun fito.
migration.backup: Kafin turawa na gaba: idan hanyar sabuntawarka tana maye gurbin babban fayil ɗin manhajar — ɗorawa ta cPanel, rubutu da zip, kwantena ba tare da volume ba — fara kwafa fayilolin media daga sabar. Maye gurbin babban fayil yana share su.
migration.note: Fayil ɗin da ya kasa ɗorawa yana riƙe da URL ɗinsa na cikin gida, don haka gudu mara cika yana barin shago mai aiki maimakon rabin karye. Sake gudanarwa yana da aminci.

Ƙara bucket na sirri, sannan ka gudanar da pnpm db:migrate private-storage don matsar da fayilolin da aka riga aka ajiye.
